subject: or_legislature/2025R1/HB2115
title: Eliminates the general rule that a sale made to a state where a taxpayer is not taxable is considered a sale in Oregon for the apportionment of business income for corporate excise tax purposes.
headline: HB 2115 did not pass

claims.text: HB 2115 was introduced in the House on January 13, 2025.
